title: Renewal Tactical Quickgrid - June 2028
content:
Renewal Tactical Quickgrid - June 2028
Purpose: lightweight, action-oriented tracker for the next 14-day sprint. Compact columns, quick scoring, and explicit next steps for escalation. Use this sheet during weekly CS sync and the tactical QBR prep.

Columns:
Account | Contract ID | ARR (USD) | Term Start | Term End | Term Months | Days to Expiry | Renewal Prob (%) | Risk Level | Best Next Step | Owner | Last Touch (YYYY-MM-DD) | Action Notes

Rows (sample data):
Acme Analytics | AC-2023-11 | 120000 | 2024-11-01 | 2029-10-31 | 60 | 511 | 75 | medium | Schedule technical QBR + pricing review | Priya Rao | 2028-06-03 | Prefers technical deep-dive; potential add-on: dedicated capacity
Helio Commerce | HC-2026-04 | 56000 | 2026-07-01 | 2029-06-30 | 36 | 20 | 35 | high | Exec alignment meeting + renewal proposal by EOW | Marco Chen | 2028-06-12 | Low usage; integration issues logged in GH-521; finance distracted by procurement cycle
Northview Labs | NV-2024-09 | 240000 | 2024-09-15 | 2028-09-14 | 48 | 92 | 92 | on_track | Auto-renew signal, send standard renewal notice | Aisha Patel | 2028-06-01 | Heavy usage, satisfied with latency improvements; flagged for upsell to dedicated
Orbit Health | OH-2027-01 | 98000 | 2025-01-20 | 2028-12-31 | 48 | 200 | 50 | medium | Confirm security/compliance timeline for Private deployment | Diego Martinez | 2028-05-28 | Security ask could delay approval; customer has pending SOC2 requirement
Vector Retail | VR-2025-10 | 42000 | 2025-10-01 | 2028-09-30 | 36 | 86 | 20 | high | Cancel-risk play: propose 3-6 month discounted bridge + enablement workshop | Priya Rao | 2028-06-05 | Churn signals: reduced call volume and decreased token consumption
QuantumEd | QE-2023-03 | 15000 | 2023-03-10 | 2028-03-09 | 60 | -93 | 100 | expired | Past-due renewal, contact A/R + legal for immediate PO | Marco Chen | 2028-04-30 | Renewal missed; contract expired; in legal review for short-term extension
StellarOps | SO-2026-11 | 78000 | 2026-11-01 | 2029-10-31 | 36 | 508 | 80 | on_track | Standard renewal cadence, schedule billing confirmation | Aisha Patel | 2028-06-08 | Stable usage; upsell opportunity: Optimize recommendations pilot
EchoFin | EF-2024-05 | 320000 | 2024-05-01 | 2029-04-30 | 60 | 691 | 60 | medium | Finance renewal play + ROI memo highlighting cost-per-token improvements | Diego Martinez | 2028-05-20 | Enterprise procurement cycle in 60-day window; CS to provide TCO slides

Quick summary formulas (for sheet):
- Total ARR in view: =SUM(C2:C9)  -> sample total 
- Weighted ARR at risk: =SUMPRODUCT(C2:C9,H2:H9/100)  -> use to prioritize targets by $ at-risk
- Days to expiry calc: =DAYS(E2,TODAY())  (or Term End - Today)

Current snapshot (sample calculations):
- Total ARR (sample rows): $1,000,000
- Weighted ARR (by probability): $615,000
- # accounts in high risk (prob <40% or Days to Expiry <30): 2
- Immediate escalation list (Days to Expiry <30 OR Risk Level == high): Helio Commerce, Vector Retail

Probability scoring rubric (compact):
- >=85%: On-track — no executive intervention required; schedule standard renewal notice
- 60-84%: Watch — targeted enablement + pricing reinforcement; owner to run ROI memo
- 40-59%: At-risk — technical QBR + finance touch; consider discounting play if procurement delayed
- <40%: High risk — immediate outreach, propose short-term bridge, loop AE/SE, and escalate to AM lead

Risk triggers and automated steps:
- Trigger A: Days to Expiry <= 30 -> schedule Exec/Finance call within 3 business days; flag in CRM and Slack #cs-renewals channel
- Trigger B: Usage drop >30% over 60 days -> open internal ticket, SE to diagnose within 48h
- Trigger C: Legal or SOC2 requirement unresolved -> CS to confirm timeline and add to private deployment track; escalate if >30 days delay

Playbook snippets (short):
- High-risk churn play (prob <40%): 1) 24-hour owner ping and AE/SE join call; 2) Offer 3-month bridge (25% off) tied to enablement milestones; 3) Commit to SLA change or dedicated pilot where applicable; 4) Confirm PO timeline and involve finance/legal.
- Upsell motion (mid/high prob): 1) Run usage + cost-per-token analysis, 2) Present Optimize recommendations (batching/quantization), 3) Offer pilot pricing for dedicated capacity, 4) Close within 45 days.

Sprint focus (next 14 days) — top actions:
1) Helio Commerce (Marco) — schedule urgent exec alignment by 2028-06-16; prepare procurement-focused summary and risk timeline.
2) Vector Retail (Priya) — propose 3-month bridge offer, enablement workshop scheduled 2028-06-18.
3) EchoFin (Diego) — deliver TCO + latency improvement ROI deck by 2028-06-15 for procurement review.
4) QuantumEd (Marco) — confirm legal short-term extension and finish PO follow-up by 2028-06-17.
5) Acme Analytics (Priya) — technical QBR prep packet due 2028-06-20; loop SE for dedicated capacity estimate.

QBR checklist for owner (quick):
- Confirm last 90 days usage trends and top 3 support incidents
- Prepare cost/benefit slide showing Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization)
- Executive summary: renewal ask + proposed offer + decision timeline
- Internal blockers: legal, finance, security (list with owners and ETA)
- Next step and owner assigned (date)

Escalation matrix (compact):
- Owner -> CS Manager -> AM Lead -> Sales Exec -> Legal (when contract terms need changes)
- Escalate after 3 failed contact attempts or if Days to Expiry <=7 and no PO in flight

Notes & context (free text):
- This sheet is intentionally compact for tactical sprints; maintain full CRM records for audit.
- Pair with QBR slides in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/RENEWAL-QBR-TEMPLATE
- Integration tickets referenced in GH: GH-521 (Helio Commerce integration), GH-642 (Vector Retail tokenization issue)

Versioning / history notes:
- 2028-06-10: initial quickgrid created (Priya)
- 2028-06-12: added Helio Commerce escalation and updated probability after last touch (Marco)
- 2028-06-14: adjusted weighted ARR formula and added QuantumEd expired row (Priya)

Quick guidance for sheet owners:
- Keep only accounts in the 14-day sprint window in this sheet; move others to the seasonal tracker.
- Update Last Touch immediately after any synchronous meeting.
- Use the Weighted ARR column to order tactical outreach each day.

End of quickgrid.
